Position: Senior Product Designer (UI/UX) - Remote
Job Summary

We are hiring on behalf of our client for a talented and experienced Senior UI/UX Designer to join their team in a fully remote role
. The ideal candidate will have 3–5 years of professional UI/UX or Product Design experience and a strong ability to transform business and user needs into intuitive, engaging, and visually compelling digital experiences. In this role, you will take ownership of the design process from discovery and user flows through wire framing, prototyping, UI design, and product delivery
, while working closely with product, business, and development teams. This is an exciting opportunity for a designer who combines strong visual skills, UX expertise, product thinking, creativity, and data-driven decision-making to contribute to impactful digital products.
Fully Remote | Saudi Market Opportunity Candidates who are Saudi nationals are particularly encouraged to apply
, in line with the client's local hiring requirements and workforce objectives.
• Lead the design process from initial concepts and user flows through to high-fidelity UI designs and interactive prototypes.
• Translate complex business and product requirements into intuitive, user-centered design solutions.
• Create high-quality wireframes, user flows, journey maps, visual designs, storyboards, site maps, and prototypes.
• Develop and maintain scalable design systems, UI components, and style guides.
• Use Figma to create and communicate high-quality design solutions.
• Develop UI/UX strategies aligned with product objectives, user needs, and the overall brand vision.
• Work closely with Product Managers, Developers, and other stakeholders to ensure designs are effectively implemented and delivered.
• Take ownership of design decisions and clearly communicate the rationale behind them.
• Collaborate with internal teams and external designers to ensure a consistent and high-quality digital experience.
• Support UX research, usability testing, and user behavior analysis to inform design decisions.
• Leverage product analytics and data to identify usability issues, understand user behavior, and improve product experiences.
• Iterate and optimize designs based on research, analytics, user feedback, and business requirements.
• Ensure consistency across typography, visual design, interaction patterns, and overall product experience.
• Contribute to establishing and improving UX/UI best practices within the product team.
Requirements
• 3–5 years of professional experience in UI/UX Design, Product Design, or a similar role.
• Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end UI/UX and product design experience.
• Advanced proficiency in Figma.
• Strong knowledge of UX principles, user-centered design, interaction design, and visual design.
• Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, user flows, journey maps, and high-fidelity UI designs.
• Hands‑on experience building or working with design systems and reusable UI components.
• Experience with Process/Journey Mapping.
• Familiarity with product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, UXCam, or similar platforms.
• Understanding of data analysis and data‑driven design.
• Strong ability to translate business objectives and user needs into practical design solutions.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Strong creativity and structured problem‑solving skills.
• High level of ownership, dedication, and attention to detail.
• Ability to work independently and effectively in a fully remote environment.
• Comfortable collaborating with cross‑functional teams across different functions and potentially different time zones.

Entry Level UX Designer - Contract Position in Medina, Saudi Arabia

We are currently seeking a talented and passionate UX Designer to join our team in Medina, Saudi Arabia. This is a contract position with a salary of 1600$ per month and includes accommodation.

As an entry level UX Designer, you will work closely with our design and development teams to create user-friendly and visually appealing digital products. Your main responsibility will be to design user interfaces and experiences that meet client needs and align with project goals. You will also have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in all stages of the design process, from research and ideation to prototyping and testing.

To excel in this role, you should have a strong understanding of user-centered design principles and be able to translate complex ideas into simple, intuitive designs. As this is an English-speaking job, fluency in English is required. Preference will be given to Indian candidates who are looking for jobs in Medina or are willing to relocate.

Responsibilities:
- Conduct user research and gather insights to inform design decisions
- Create wireframes, prototypes, and mockups for digital products
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure designs meet project requirements
- Test designs with users and gather feedback for iteration
- Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in UX design

Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design or related field
- Proven experience with Adobe Creative Suite or other design software
- Strong portfolio showcasing previous UX design work
- Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal
- Ability to work independently as well as part of a team
- Understanding of HTML/CSS is a plus

This contract position offers a great opportunity for freshers who are looking for an entry-level job in UX design. Our company provides a supportive learning environment where you can grow your skills while working on exciting projects. If you have a passion for creating user-friendly designs and are willing to embrace new challenges, we would love to have you join our team in Medina, Saudi Arabia.
